BiblicalUsage: Hagar is the mother of Ishmael. In Genesis 16:1, the text says "whose name [was] Hagar." The life behind the name is told on the Hagar People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hagar matters because God knows His people by name, and Hagar is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
